messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered - eu-west canary wave showing elevated 5xx and failing healthchecks. Kill-switch condition met (>=3% 5xx over 5m). Auto-pause executed. Creating thread for live mitigation and handoff.

sam: oncall here, I see the alerts, joining.

priya: looking at logs now, lots of 502/5xx from model-serving pods. getting pod list and recent logs.

matt: FYI I can toggle the rollout flag if needed. standing by.

elena: are we certain this is the new quantized variant? any obvious errors?

priya: early trace shows repeated kvcache errors + eviction churn: ```[WARN] kvcache: shard=12 evicting due to checksum mismatch
[kvcache] error: invalid-shard-state at kv_shard.go:214``` looks like state corruption after warmup.

sam: ok, that's actionable. @matt can you flip the kill-switch now? :eyes:

matt: toggled feature_flag.rollout_eu_west -> false :white_check_mark: (kill-switch). Confirmed traffic steering paused for wave3.

elena: checking traffic - ingress dropped to 0 for the affected canary pool, but some drain-induced 5xx still observed from leftover pods.

megan-cs: heads-up: two paying customers (ACME Corp, BrightCo) reported client errors ~3-5 mins ago. I've opened support tickets and sent a brief apology note. Will escalate if they ask for credits.

priya: capturing core dumps and dumping model shard metadata. Snapshotting node metrics and quantization config now.

matt: starting rollback to image tag previous_v1.7 for canary-service in eu-west. Command: ```kubectl set image deploy/canary-service canary=registry/redwood/canary:previous_v1.7 -n eu-west``` Jobs queued.

ops-bot: deploy: rollback initiated for canary-service/eu-west by matt. build/prev_v1.7 pulled, pods recreating.

sam: monitoring dashboards: 5xx rate dropping from 3.4% -> 1.1% in 3m after kill-switch + rollback start. Latency trending down.

elena: good. once pods finish drain/replace we should see stable numbers. keep checking logs for kvcache sigs.

priya: also adding a temporary alert rule to block future rollouts if kvcache checksum errors appear in prod. Will push an operator rule to the canary gating policy.

megan-cs: I sent customers a short follow-up: we paused the canary and are rolling back; will provide ETA and follow-up RCA.

sam: oncall handoff: I'm scheduled to hand to @next-oncall in ~40m. If stability holds for 20m after rollback completion we can close the incident; otherwise escalate to SRE pager.

priya: extracting model telemetry for postmortem (quant params, tokenizer checksum, kvcache version). Assigning RCAs to @priya + @matt. elena will coordinate customer comms.

incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigated -> traffic for affected canary paused; rollback in progress; customer notifications sent.

sam: leaving this thread pinned. will hand off with summary at 1759997860. Thanks everyone, stay available for followups. :thumbsup:
